params.caption: 🎮 Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance expansion may get a beta Recent changes to the Monster Hunter Wilds beta app on Steam's backend hint that players could get to try the upcoming Ascendance expansion early. Capcom has not announced a beta; the expansion itself is due sometime next year. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 14:16 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #MonsterHunterWilds #Capcom #GamingNews
